title: Kissed Charred Norwegian Katsuobushi Skewers
description: A low-carb Norwegian dish featuring charred katsuobushi, perfect for a date night, with a bouncy qq texture from the katsuramuki-cut technique.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the katsuobushi onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the katsuobushi.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and garnish with chopped parsley.
Make sure to cook the katsuobushi to an internal temperature of at least 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the skewers rest for a minute or two before serving.
